purpose: Reference-only GIS style and icon catalog for general GIS workflows; KML/KMZ is a specialized consumer. User-owned or source-authored imported KMZ styling is authoritative. External assets are not bundled or silently recolored.

sources.notes: Primary reference; inspect Esri, USGS, BGS, DGGS and font licenses individually; QGIS source conversions not a warranty of rendering fidelity

sources.name: Mapbox Maki

sources.name: Temaki
sources.license: Public-domain dedication / CC0-style
sources.redistribution: public-domain dedication where legally valid; review local rights
sources.kmz_use: new-feature-only: transparent PNG from checked SVG
sources.notes: Maki companion with more specialized POI categories; check pinned icon IDs/version.

sources.name: Map Icons Collection (Nicolas Mollet)
sources.license: CC BY-SA 3.0
sources.redistribution: credit source; ShareAlike for adapted icons; evaluate export obligations
sources.kmz_use: new-feature-only: embed asset and preserve attribution obligations
sources.notes: Since 2026-10-14, site offers customizable SVG and PNG; verify per-icon derivative/trademark conditions. CC BY-SA 3.0 credit/adapted-artwork ShareAlike; do not hotlink images. For new/user-edited features only; never overwrite imported KMZ icons.

sources.name: Scott de Jonge Map Icons
sources.license: Mixed: MIT code; SIL OFL 1.1 fonts; CC BY 3.0 docs
sources.kmz_use: new-feature-only: rasterized export after font license review
sources.notes: Upstream deprecates project; HTML/CSS icons cannot be used natively as KML IconStyle.

sources.name: Leaflet ExtraMarkers
sources.license: MIT plugin; external icon font licenses separate
sources.redistribution: retain MIT notice; separately review font/icon use
sources.kmz_use: new-feature-only: export rendered pin as PNG then embed
sources.notes: This is a Leaflet renderer, not native KMZ import/export support.

sources.name: Google Material Symbols
sources.license: Apache-2.0
sources.kmz_use: new-feature-only: SVG/PNG icon exported as PNG and embedded

sources.name: Leaflet AwesomeMarkers
sources.license: MIT plugin/colored markers; dependency licenses vary
sources.redistribution: MIT notice for plugin; check dependent fonts
sources.kmz_use: new-feature-only: export generated pin to PNG + embed
sources.notes: Older Leaflet plugin and font dependencies: do not assume interoperability with Cesium/KML.

sources.name: CesiumJS PinBuilder
sources.license: CesiumJS engine license; icon inputs independently licensed
sources.redistribution: check Cesium version and input icon rights
sources.kmz_use: only for new/user-restyled features; PNG export and pack with relative href
sources.notes: Canvas pin builder is NOT an importer and must never override existing KML Style/StyleMap.

sources.name: Streamline — Google Earth Placemark search
sources.license: Mixed: certain named Open Source sets CC BY 4.0; other free sets are restricted; premium requires separate license
sources.redistribution: DO NOT include default free/premium Streamline assets in selectable/reusable/icon-download manager; select explicitly licensed open-source sets and review exact terms/attribution
sources.kmz_use: new-feature-only if selected source set independently permits bundling/reuse; otherwise external design inspiration only
sources.notes: Search/category page aggregates unrelated families with different licensing; generic 'free' Streamline asset license expressly bars use as an in-app selectable, customizable or downloadable asset library. Open Source sets need own CC BY 4.0 attribution and verification; no copying gallery wholesale.

sources.name: Mapular — Map Icon Creator
sources.license: Website says user-created outputs may be used commercially; original site/app source code is NOT offered under an identified open-source license
sources.redistribution: Use own independently implemented generator; do not copy site source/code/interface artwork; uploaded third-party logos retain their original rights
sources.kmz_use: new-feature-only: generated PNG may be packaged inside user-authored KMZ; existing imported KML icon stays unchanged
sources.notes: Four pin shapes, 80+ selectable Lucide icons, color/border/logo and PNG/SVG exports; source says browser-local. Use as functional inspiration for independently implemented icon manager; no licensing assumption on platform code.
